name: WLF_LI_ELEARNINGS_F
description: This table is used to store elearning items information.

columns.name: ELEARNING_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: ELEARNING_TYPE
columns.description: This column is used to represents different elearning item types

columns.name: ELEARNING_CATEGORY
columns.description: Column used to differentiate elearning types denormalized from learning_item_category

columns.name: LEARNING_ITEM_ID
columns.description: This column behaves as foriegn key and  refers to parent table column

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: This column populates source_type of elearning for category

columns.name: CREATED_BY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the person identifier who created the object.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: RELATED_CONTENT_ID
columns.description: This is column holds value of content LEARNING_ITEM_ID from WLF_LEARNING_ITEMS_F table of ORA_CONTENT_ROOT learning item type related to ELearning

columns.name: CONTENT_DELETE_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code for content deletion

columns.name: CONTENT_DELETE_DATE
columns.description: Content Delete Date

columns.name: CAPACITY_ENABLED
columns.description: Property to represent if capacity is enabled

columns.name: CAPACITY_MINIMUM
columns.description: Minimum capacity setting

columns.name: CAPACITY_MAXIMUM
columns.description: Maximum capacity setting

columns.name: WAITLIST_ENABLED
columns.description: Property to represent if waitlist is enabled

columns.name: WAITLIST_MAXIMUM_ENABLED
columns.description: Property to represent if waitlist maximum capacity is enabled

columns.name: WAITLIST_MAXIMUM
columns.description: Maximum waitlist setting

columns.name: WAITLIST_RULE
columns.description: Waitlisting rule on who can add learners to waitlist

columns.name: TRAINING_SUPPLIER_ID
columns.description: Training supplier id

columns.name: PARENT_LEARNING_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Parent (Ex : Course) Learning Item Id to which Event is associated with.

columns.name: CLOSED_DATE
columns.description: Learning Item closed date

columns.name: CLOSED_ACTIVITY_STATUS
columns.description: Operation for closed event

columns.name: CLOSED_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code for closed event
